```plato

    // Not derivable GENERICALLY here: Contains(point|bounds), Union, Intersection,
    // Expand, and corner enumeration need component-wise Min/Max (a ILattice) on
    // TPoint, which Point2D/Point3D do not implement. They ARE expressible on the
    // CONCRETE Bounds2D/Bounds3D via per-axis (X/Y/Z) field access, so the mirror of
    // the IInterval surface is written concretely below (items 29, 185). Making the
    // point types ILattice/IClampable would let it collapse back to one generic body.

    //==
    // Bounds2D / Bounds3D — concrete AABB operations
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Axis-aligned_bounding_box).
    // Convention: bounds are INCLUSIVE on Min and Max; an inverted box (Min greater
    // than Max on any axis) is EMPTY and is the identity for Union — this is what makes
    // "grow from Empty()" correct (Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Bounds). Endpoints
    // reached via the Number Min/Max lattice ops, exactly as BoundsOfPoints does.

    // The canonical empty box: Min at +infinity, Max at -infinity, so it contains no
    // point and is absorbed by Union with any real box (the empty sentinel).
    Empty(_: Bounds2D): Bounds2D
        => (Point2D(Number.MaxValue, Number.MaxValue), Point2D(Number.MinValue, Number.MinValue));
```
